utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: This one. Okay. Pull the pin. Do it.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Wait, Grandma, if I just yank it horizontally it should pop right out. It’s faster that way.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: No, no, no! You'll snap the housing doing that. You have to twist it clockwise first to release the tension, then slide it. We aren't in a race.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: But it’s a spring-loaded pin! My teacher said yanking is the standard way so it doesn't get stuck midway.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: I don't care what your teacher said, I've had this machine forty years and if you yank it, you'll ruin it. Now, hold it steady and wait until I say so. We’re doing it the right way or not at all.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Here we go. Here we go.

utterances.speaker: grandmother
utterances.text: Pull the pin. Let's do that after. Okay, now push down on that thing. Just hold it down like that a little bit.

utterances.speaker: granddaughter
utterances.text: Oops. Okay, let go of it.
